## Description

Uses the checksums and sizes from [02_create_manifest.sh](#help-02_create_manifest) to find files with identical content and files with zero bytes. It prints a summary to the log and writes two Markdown reports, which [24_amend_report.sh](#help-24_amend_report) copies into the report.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/06_check_duplicates_and_zero_bytes.sh <directory> [tag] [date]
```

- `directory` - Deposit directory (used in the log summary).
- `tag` - Optional suffix of the manifest files to read.
- `date` - Date stamp of the manifest, `YYYY-MM-DD` (default: today). Pass it when the manifest was created on a different day.

## Inputs and outputs

- Reads `generated/manifest[.tag].<date>.sha256` and `generated/metadata[.tag].txt`
- Writes `generated/duplicate-files-report[.tag].<date>.md` and `generated/zero-byte-files-report[.tag].<date>.md`
